name: pi-fleet
description: Local-network fleet manager for Raspberry Pis: health, journals, package updates, network traffic, and an attention-first dashboard.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pi-fleet/server && npm run build -w @pi-fleet/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pi-fleet/server && npm run test -w @pi-fleet/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @pi-fleet/server && npm run typecheck -w @pi-fleet/web
